node.statement: Write G=g_{sJ} and Z_T=T+G(T). Since sJ is unitary and (sJ)^dagger=sJ, exact unitality and bilinearity reduce the displayed graph equation to 0=f_{sJ}(Z_T)=G(T)+(1/2) Z_T^dagger bold-dot Z_T. At T=0, G=0 is a solution, so uniqueness in lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control gives G(0)=0; its derivative bound d=C_g*(epsilon_r+delta)<=k_g<=1/2 then gives ||G(T)||<=d||T||.
